capabilities.name: Experience Design
capabilities.description: Translates validated user needs into concrete interface designs, prototypes, and a coherent design system ready for engineering handoff.

services.name: Information Architecture Map
services.contractDescription: Content structure, taxonomy, site map, and navigation flow diagram.

services.name: Wireframes
services.contractDescription: Low-fidelity and high-fidelity interface layout designs across key responsive break-points.

services.name: Clickable Prototype
services.contractDescription: Interactive screen transitions and user flow prototype for usability testing.

services.name: Design System & UI Kit
services.contractDescription: Reusable UI components, color palettes, typography, spacing scale, and interaction states.

services.name: Design Tokens
services.contractDescription: Machine-readable design system variables for color, typography, borders, and shadows.

services.name: Content Strategy & Voice/Tone Guide
services.contractDescription: Microcopy standards, content hierarchy guidelines, and error message voice tone.

services.name: Accessibility Compliance Checklist
services.contractDescription: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast, keyboard navigation, and screen reader compliance audit checklist.

services.name: Usability Test Plan & Report
services.contractDescription: Usability testing script, user session recordings analysis, and task success metrics report.

checklists.name: Experience Design (SDLC Phase 2) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for UX/UI design assets, design tokens, and accessibility standards.

items.statement: Design decisions in the wireframes and prototypes are traceable back to discovery research and usability findings.
Color contrast ratios across all text and interactive UI elements satisfy WCAG 2.1 AA standard (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).
Interactive prototype has been tested with at least 3 representative users with documented task completion rates.
Design tokens (color, typography, spacing, border radii) are extracted and ready for frontend implementation.
Responsive breakpoint behavior (mobile, tablet, desktop) is explicitly defined for all key views.

reviewGates.name: Experience Design Review
reviewGates.statement: The UX/UI Design Specification (wireframes, prototype, design system) has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Technical Discovery & Architecture.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the UX/UI Design Specification sufficiently detailed, usable, and accessible to guide implementation?
